scope: Static order-and-receipts comparison, preserved experiment evidence and downloadable regression cases. No failure-lab compute or execution endpoint was recreated.

verification.method: Anonymous HTTPS GET using certificate and hostname verification; no cookies, Authorization header, AWS credentials, or signed URLs sent.

limitations: This static hosting result does not run a new AWS failure experiment.
Public CDN transfer remains usage-based; a planning allowance is not an AWS hard billing cap.
Billing observations remain estimated and exclude unposted usage.
